_meta.semantics: covers_syllabus_refs is an index of the objectives a stage is principally associated with; coverage is claimed only through _syllabus_items + covers_items, and only as far as coverage_check.py confirms.

_items_source.document: CILEX Professional Qualification (CPQ) Foundation Stage module specifications F1-F6 (published at cilex.org.uk/wp-content/uploads/: cpq_f1_legal_systems_module.pdf, cpq_f2_law_of_tort_module.pdf, cpq_f3_contract_law_module.pdf, cpq_f4_property_and_private_client.pdf, cpq_f5_f6_professional_and_legal_skills_module.pdf) and the CPQ Foundation assessment overview (cpq_assessment_overview.pdf), read directly from cilex.org.uk
_items_source.version: CPQ Foundation Stage module specifications, version 2 (updated July 2022, the version live on cilex.org.uk), linked from cilex.org.uk/study/cpq_current_trainees/assessed_modules/ and itemised 2026-09-27
_items_source.numbering: CILEX numbers each F-module's content areas as a table of numbered rows (1, 2, 3...) with lettered sub-points (a, b, c...) but leaves the bullet detail under each sub-point unnumbered. This course codes F1 Legal Systems as LS.1-LS.9 (its 9 numbered rows), F2 The Law of Tort as TORT.1-TORT.8, F3 Contract Law as CON.1-CON.8, F4 Introduction to Property and Private Client as PPC.1-PPC.17, and the F5/F6 Professional and Legal Skills module (which numbers its content continuously across both linked assessments) as PLS.1-PLS.8, with PLS.1-PLS.7 examined under F5 (Succeeding in the Legal Environment) and PLS.8 under F6 (Legal Research), matching the module document's own row numbers.
